title: プロジェクトデザイン特別科目(PDプラクティカルソリューション)(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: Special Subject - Design Project(PD Practical Solutions)

(Provided by all courses)

educationalGoal: This course is one of a group of project design courses. Students will work in teams to solve familiar problems by utilizing the skills and ideas they have learned in the previous subjects, and solve problems based on logical thinking. They also engage in project design activities with a view to more practical social implementation by conducting demonstration experiments of proposed solutions at actual sites as needed.
advice: Based on the basic skills acquired in the preceding courses, students in this course will engage in organized project activities to solve problems in the real world in which they will be involved. In the field on campus, students will discover problems, understand the current situation, and decide on issues in situations in which they will be the parties to the problem. In examining the solutions, we examine the evaluation values and determine the target values to determine how changes in the current values can be regarded as a solution to the problem. Through these processes, highly feasible and effective solutions are considered in order to achieve the goal. In addition, we will develop an experimental plan for how to demonstrate the solution in the actual field and collect the necessary data. By analyzing the data, we will evaluate whether the proposed solutions are effective or not. In these processes, students aim to conduct creative project activities by utilizing their own expertise in addition to the basic skills acquired in Project Design I and Project Design II.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and experience acquired through studies in Project Design I, Project Design II, and their own areas of specialization.

activityGoals.body: Able to gather information and recognize problems with respect to issues for which the solutions are diverse.
Able to think logically based on data, facts, and truth
Able to explore and creatively find new challenges

achievementLevels.ideal: 1.Able to analyze various information on the main theme, identify the need for a solution, and establish a project theme. 2.Able to work in teams on organized project activities to solve problems of others in the real world. 3.Able to propose ideas for solving other people's problems in the real world, making use of their expertise.
achievementLevels.standard: 1.Able to find the project theme from the main theme. 2.Able to make logical evaluations and make decisions based on data and facts by gathering information. 3.Able to conduct project activities in teams to solve problems of others in the real world.

lessons.content: Team Build and Current Status Analysis The team will check the situation of each team and conduct research and analysis to determine what the current problems are and the figures that provide the basis for these problems.

Causal Analysis and Assessment Values Analyze the causes of the identified problems. Based on the results of the previous study, we will also examine the evaluation values that best describe the problem.
Determination of issues The direction in which issues are to be resolved is examined, and a target value for how much the evaluation value is to be improved is determined.
Discussion of proposed solutions Examine the requirements that the idea must meet in order to solve the determined problem.
Concretization of Solution Ideas Ideas that satisfy the required specifications are considered, including a concrete production method.
Design Report Specific ideas, their production methods, and necessary components are discussed.
Implementation of Idea 1 Implement the proposed idea.
Implementation of Idea 2 Implement the proposed idea.
Implementation Testing Test the implemented idea and evaluate whether it meets the initially set specifications.
Planning a Demonstration Experiment Consider how to conduct experiments in the field and collect data using the ideas you have embodied.
Demonstration Experiments Conduct planned demonstration experiments and collect data.
Analysis of Collected Data Analyze the data collected in the demonstration experiment.
Preparation for Reporting Results Prepare presentation materials for reporting the results of this project.
Presentation of Results The results of this project will be reported.
Self-Evaluation and Reflection Reflection on the project activities.
